mapper.insert: insert into hr_appointment(emp_id, appointment_type, before_department_id, after_department_id, before_job_id, after_job_id, effective_date, reason, register_id) values(#{emp.empId}, #{appointmentType}, #{beforeDepartment.departmentId, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{afterDepartment.departmentId, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{beforeJob.jobId, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{afterJob.jobId, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{effectiveDate}, #{reason}, #{register.empId, jdbcType=INTEGER})
mapper.select: select a.hr_appointment_id, a.appointment_type, a.effective_date, a.reason, a.created_at, bd.department_id bd_department_id, bd.department_name bd_department_name, ad.department_id ad_department_id, ad.department_name ad_department_name, bj.job_id bj_job_id, bj.job_name bj_job_name, aj.job_id aj_job_id, aj.job_name aj_job_name, r.emp_id r_emp_id, r.ename r_ename from hr_appointment a left join department bd on bd.department_id = a.before_department_id left join department ad on ad.department_id = a.after_department_id left join job bj on bj.job_id = a.before_job_id left join job aj on aj.job_id = a.after_job_id left join emp r on r.emp_id = a.register_id where a.emp_id = #{empId} order by a.effective_date desc, a.hr_appointment_id desc
